How it works

One place for campus lost & found

Designed around the real journey from losing an item to getting it safely back to its owner.

📝

Report

Students submit lost or found items with category, date, location and identifying details.

🔎

Smart Matching

The system compares category, date, location and description to surface potential matches.

🛡️

Secure Return

Hidden details, student verification and staff approval reduce fraudulent claims.

Secure claims

Not everyone who says “it’s mine” gets the item.

Public listings intentionally reveal only basic information. The real owner must know details that were never displayed publicly. Valuable items can then be released through campus staff after verification.

1
Limited public listing
Brand, contents and unique marks can remain hidden.
2
Ownership questions
Claimants describe hidden details, location and time.
3
Student identity
Claims are linked to an ING student account / ID.
4
Staff approval
Reception or authorized staff approve valuable-item collection.

How It Works

Our simple 4-step process helps students report and recover lost items quickly and securely.

Step 1
▤

Report Item

Fill out a simple lost or found form with the item category, location, date and description. Sensitive identifying details can remain private.

Step 2
⌕

Search & Match

Browse reported items or use potential matches based on category, date, location and description from your report.

Step 3
🛡

Claim & Verify

Submit hidden item details and your ING student ID. Valuable items are reviewed by authorized campus staff before release.

Step 4
✓

Recover Item

Once ownership is approved, collect the item from the designated campus point and the report is marked as resolved.
